metadata.question: Were chlorophyll concertrations at 100km radius around (-41.729403, -125.410394) up during November 2019 to February 2020 in comparison to the same time the prior year?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use MODIS Aqua Chlorophyll (OC product) at 1 km resolution (chlor_a band) for the targeted Pacific Ocean location. Apply same-month, different-year windows: - Nov−Feb 2019/2020 (2019-11-01 ➝ 2020-02-29) - Nov−Feb 2018/2019 (2018-11-01 ➝ 2019-02-28) 2. Masking: Land/no-data already set as flags; use the built-in quality mask (clear sky, weight ≥ 1) provided by chlor_a’s QA flags (keep only valid pixels). 3. Geometry: circular buffer (100 km) around the lon/lat point. 4. Logic to decide “up”: Compute mean chlorophyll inside buffer for each season. – If either collection is empty → C1 – If masked valid-pixel count = 0 → C2 – If resulting mean is NaN/None → C3 – 2020-season mean > 2019-season mean → A; else → B. ```python import ee; ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') pt = ee.Geometry.Point([-125.410394, -41.729403]) roi = pt.buffer(100_000) def get_chl_period(year, end_year=None): start, end = f"{year}-11-01", f"{end_year}-02-28" return (ee.ImageCollection("NASA/OCEANDATA/MODIS-Aqua/L3SMI") .filterDate(start, end) .select('chlor_a') .map(lambda img: img.updateMask(img.neq(32767))) # respect valid flag ) col20 = get_chl_period(2019, 2020) if col20.size().getInfo() == 0: print("No MODIS-Chl 2019–2020.") print("C1") col19 = get_chl_period(2018, 2019) if col19.size().getInfo() == 0: print("No MODIS-Chl 2018–2019.") print("C1") def mean_chl(coll): img = coll.mean().clip(roi) c = img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=roi, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('chlor_a').getInfo() m = img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=roi, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('chlor_a').getInfo() return None if c == 0 else m, c chl20, cnt20 = mean_chl(col20) chl19, cnt19 = mean_chl(col19) if chl20 is None or chl19 is None: print("Valid pixels: C2.") print("C2") if chl20 is None or chl19 is None or ee.Algorithms.IsNaN(chl20) or ee.Algorithms.IsNaN(chl19): print("NaN result.") print("C3") print(f"Chl 2019–20: {chl20:.2f} mg/m3, Pixels: {cnt20}") print(f"Chl 2018–19: {chl19:.2f} mg/m3, Pixels: {cnt19}") print("A" if chl20 > chl19 else "B") ```
data.code:
import ee; ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

pt = ee.Geometry.Point([-125.410394, -41.729403])
roi = pt.buffer(100_000)

def get_chl_period(year, end_year=None):
    start, end = f"{year}-11-01", f"{end_year}-02-28"
    return (ee.ImageCollection("NASA/OCEANDATA/MODIS-Aqua/L3SMI")
              .filterDate(start, end)
              .select('chlor_a')
              .map(lambda img: img.updateMask(img.neq(32767)))  # respect valid flag
           )

col20 = get_chl_period(2019, 2020)
if col20.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("No MODIS-Chl 2019–2020.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")

col19 = get_chl_period(2018, 2019)
if col19.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("No MODIS-Chl 2018–2019.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")

def mean_chl(coll):
    img = coll.mean().clip(roi)
    c = img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=roi, scale=1000,
                         maxPixels=1e9).get('chlor_a').getInfo()
    m = img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=roi, scale=1000,
                         maxPixels=1e9).get('chlor_a').getInfo()
    return None if c == 0 else m, c

chl20, cnt20 = mean_chl(col20)
chl19, cnt19 = mean_chl(col19)

if chl20 is None or chl19 is None:
    print("Valid pixels: C2.")
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")

if chl20 is None or chl19 is None or ee.Algorithms.IsNaN(chl20) or ee.Algorithms.IsNaN(chl19):
    print("NaN result.")
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")

print(f"Chl 2019–20: {chl20:.2f} mg/m3, Pixels: {cnt20}")
print(f"Chl 2018–19: {chl19:.2f} mg/m3, Pixels: {cnt19}")

print("<answer>A</answer>" if chl20 > chl19 else "<answer>B</answer>")
